scope: Momo-only authored parts candidate. Same Noah method, native and Pixel unverified.

sources.prompt:
Create a production-quality transparent separated sprite parts sheet for MOMO ONLY, the WHITE FLOPPY-EARED BUNNY in the FIRST COLUMN of the first reference image (pink flower bonnet, pink bow, white-and-pink heart/petal dress, burgundy ruby eyes, rounded white rabbit paws). The other five characters in the atlas MUST NOT appear. Preserve precisely Momo's canonical species, delicate face/eye shape, pink-and-white colors, flower hat details, dress scallops/hearts, plush body proportions and cute silhouette. This is a faithful directional adaptation of existing art, not a redesign.

SECOND reference shows the approved Noah production technique and sheet quality. Use that technique ONLY: hand-painted kawaii 2D watercolor/gouache soft volume, crisp fine warm outlines, subtle consistent top-left light, NOT full3D, NOT a flattened entire character.

Draw Momo turned THREE-QUARTER LEFT, looking left; all visible left-facing head, arms, toes and torso aligned consistently. Independently paint hidden joints so parts can overlap cleanly. All shapes completely separated on transparent canvas; NO cast shadows, no floor, no backdrop, no outlines around cells, no text/labels.
Exactly TWO ROWS with FOUR equal spacious cells, with a minimum transparent 25px gutter at every cell boundary:
TOP ROW left→right:
1. Full LEFT three-quarter HEAD including flower bonnet, both original floppy ears and hair, open normal eyes, NO neck/body.
2. LEFT three-quarter TORSO including pink neck bow and entire pink heart-patterned dress/skirt, but NO head, NO hands, NO arms, NO legs or feet. Leave clean hidden shoulder attachment areas. Dress proportions same canonical.
3. FAR ARM with small white bunny paw and pink short sleeve, open natural downward angle, upper shoulder attachment included.
4. NEAR ARM with small white bunny paw and pink short sleeve, natural downward angle.
BOTTOM ROW left→right:
5. FAR LEG and WHITE BUNNY FOOT, complete small hidden knee attachment, left-facing toes.
6. NEAR LEG and WHITE BUNNY FOOT, same canonical scale and left-facing toes.
7. A SMALL WHITE ROUND RABBIT TAIL, never a fox/squirrel tail; modest canonical rabbit puff, no oversized tail.
8. EXACT SAME HEAD as cell1 in same direction, same bonnet/ears/hair/silhouette, but eyes gently CLOSED for a blink. Do not add a different expression, mouth pose or cheek color; only eyelids change.
Use generous empty gutters. The head cells should be large and high quality, no cropping of hat or ears. Tail small naturally. No extra detached fingers or duplicate limb remnants on the dress. Do NOT include a whole assembled character. Transparent background.

Correct this MOMO LEFT parts sheet for a game rig. Keep the exact same composition, the same eight independent parts in the same positions, same canonical Momo face/eyes/hat/ears, same painting style. Only fix the TORSO in top row cell2: REMOVE both white paw/hand balls beside the neck bow; the torso must contain NO limbs whatsoever, just neck bow and dress, with plain hidden shoulder sockets. Replace the overly clover-like dress motifs with the canonical small pink HEART motifs visible on Momo in FIRST COLUMN of second reference. Preserve the skirt shape and its layered scalloped pink hem. Do NOT change any other body part, do not add a full assembled character. Keep cell1 open-eye head and cell8 closed-eye head same silhouette/registration and same small cheerful mouth. Fully transparent background, no floor/shadows. Raw alpha cutout, preserve all gutters.

Make the matching RIGHT-THREE-QUARTER independent sprite parts for canonical MOMO, white floppy-eared rabbit in pink flower bonnet and pink/white HEART-patterned dress (FIRST character of second reference). Use first reference as exact same character/material/style guide. This is a different directional drawing, NEVER simply mirror the first sheet (hat flowers and body details stay anatomically correct). Same adorable burgundy-red eyes, same small mouth, face, fluffy ears, flower bonnet, bow, proportions and pastel palette. DO NOT redesign, do not create any other characters. Faithful soft-volume watercolor game art matching approved Noah parts approach. Fully transparent alpha background, no shadows, no backdrop, no text/grid.

Exactly 8 entirely separated parts in TWO ROWS x FOUR CELLS, with wide empty gutters; no crossing cells:
top row: (1) three-quarter RIGHT HEAD, hat and ears, eyes open; (2) RIGHT TORSO/dress and neck bow only, NO arms, NO hands, NO white paw remnants on shoulders, NO legs; (3) FAR white bunny arm+paw with small pink sleeve, right direction; (4) NEAR white bunny arm+paw pink sleeve.
bottom row: (5) FAR white bunny lower leg and FOOT with toes pointing RIGHT; (6) NEAR leg and FOOT pointing RIGHT; (7) small white round BUNNY TAIL, no fox/squirrel tail; (8) same exact head/hat/ears and same registration as cell1 but softly CLOSED EYELIDS for blink, same mouth, no other facial change.
The torso has small pink HEART motifs, scalloped white skirt with pink layered ruffles, clean hidden joint sockets, zero arms/hands embedded. Keep large high-quality parts comparable to first reference. Do not include an assembled character.

Create the matching REAR/BACK independent sprite parts sheet of MOMO, the canonical white floppy-eared rabbit with pink flower bonnet and white/pink layered heart dress. Reference1 gives her approved style/costume/proportions; reference2 FIRST COLUMN is formal original. BACK VIEW: no face, eyes, nose or front mouth visible. Keep exactly same bonnet brim and pink flower decorations, both fluffy floppy ears hanging, white hair back; no new ribbons or costume redesign. Dress BACK has same pink-and-white scalloped layers, little heart motifs, simple back closure, no front neck bow on her back. Soft painted cute volume, warm fine outlines, no full3D.

Transparent alpha background, zero floor/shadows/text/grid. Eight isolated parts, exactly two rows four cells with generous gutters:
TOP: 1 full BACK HEAD/flower bonnet/ears, no torso; 2 BACK TORSO/dress only, NO arms/hands/feet and no front chest bow; 3 FAR arm white bunny paw and pink sleeve as seen from BACK; 4 NEAR matching rear arm.
BOTTOM: 5 FAR white foot/short leg viewed from BACK with small heel, toes point away/up; 6 NEAR rear heel/leg; 7 SMALL white round rabbit tail seen from behind, entirely separate; 8 repeat BACK HEAD only (same neutral registration, no face).
Momo is round and delicate, not taller or narrower, preserve the shape and layered dress. Each part includes hidden joint area. No whole character. No other characters. Do not draw cream belly patterns, front face or chest bow in rear parts.

Fix ONLY the spacing/part separation of this Momo REAR sprite sheet. Preserve exact rear character style, bonnet, ears, pink heart dress, color and all other parts. The top-left BACK HEAD and top-second BACK TORSO currently touch/overlap at their adjoining edges: separate them by at least 40 transparent pixels. Slightly reposition them within their cells, do not change their design or squash them. The back head must contain only hat+white hair+ears, no part of the dress; torso must contain only dress with no part of hair/ears/hands. Also make the two bottom-left REAR feet smooth rounded white HEELS without front toe segmentation; feet face away from viewer, not sideways. Keep the original eight-part TWO-ROW FOUR-COLUMN arrangement with roomy gutters and no assembled character. Transparent alpha background, no text, floor or cast shadows.
